stem: A child with gastroenteritis is alert, well perfused and tolerating oral rehydration solution. What is the most appropriate management?

options.text: Discharge with oral rehydration advice and safety-netting

explanation: A child with gastroenteritis who is clinically well and tolerating oral rehydration can usually be managed with oral rehydration, caregiver advice and clear return precautions.
